title: Recursive relation for a fixed number of steps
statement: Fix a width $w$ and a relation $E$ on pairs of Boolean lists. At zero steps, the relation between $A$ and $B$ means $A=B$. At $k+1$ steps, it means there is a Boolean list $z$ of length $w$ such that the relation holds from $A$ to $z$ in $k$ steps and $E(z,B)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: Relation E on pairs of Boolean lists
